approved_by: study owner, FINAL_FREEZE_AND_START_B200.md §3 (2026-10-06): revision-2 rule (aligned evidence is not automatically mandatory) approved; eight needs-review decisions and 14 flagged-item repairs applied; approval recorded after contract/rules/audit consistency and leak checks

functional_semantics.triton: C = A @ B, fp32 accumulator, cast to c dtype at the store (impl_triton.py:67-79).
functional_semantics.cutile: C = A @ B, fp32 accumulator, cast to C.dtype at the store (impl_cutile.py:55-68).
functional_semantics.note: Both match impl_torch.py:21-27 (torch.matmul under allow_tf32=True; fp8 via _scaled_mm with unit scales then cast to e4m3fn). Generator tensors.py:416-436 scales both operands by K**-0.5 and returns row-major (a, b).

stages.triton: allocation + descriptor construction + one GEMM launch (impl_triton.py:131-164).
stages.note: Single-kernel blocked GEMM with grouped tile ordering on both sides (impl_triton.py:54-62, impl_cutile.py:43-53).

dependencies.triton: kernel depends on c and on bt (impl_triton.py:132,137-139).
dependencies.note: No intermediates besides the Triton-side bt (see preprocessing).

reduction_scan_sort.triton: sequential K loop in BLOCK_K chunks via tl.range, MMA accumulation (impl_triton.py:69-76).
reduction_scan_sort.cutile: sequential K loop with compile-time trip count, MMA accumulation (impl_cutile.py:56-66).
reduction_scan_sort.note: Same ascending-k sequential reduction; no split-K on either side.

precision.triton: input_precision='tf32' passed for every dtype (impl_triton.py:76): TF32 operands for fp32, native fp16/fp8 operands otherwise; fp32 accumulation; single cast at the store (79).
precision.cutile: mma_dtype = tfloat32 only when A is fp32, else native dtype (impl_cutile.py:59,63,65); fp32 accumulation; single cast at the store (68).
precision.note: Effectively the same precision path on both sides (the tf32 flag is a no-op for non-fp32 operands). fp8 is consumed unscaled on both sides, consistent with the reference's unit scales. Both round the fp32 accumulator once to e4m3fn whereas the reference rounds via bf16 (impl_torch.py:24-26); config.verify atol 5.0 / rtol 0.1 covers it.

preprocessing.triton: bt = b.t().contiguous() (N, K) cached in the module-level plain dict _bt_cache keyed by (b.data_ptr(), shape, dtype), never evicted (impl_triton.py:32-39), looked up on every run (132): the transpose copy executes once per distinct B (warmup) and is untimed thereafter.
preprocessing.cutile: B consumed row-major as (TK, TN) tiles directly (impl_cutile.py:64-65); no cache, no transpose, no descriptors.
preprocessing.note: Decided 2026-10-06 (owner, FINAL_FREEZE_AND_START_B200.md §3): B is delivered row-major and no prepacked input may be assumed; consuming it directly (cuTile side) or through a K-major copy rebuilt by device work inside every run() is a mapping choice, so the layout divergence is mapping-only. Any cross-call cache of a transformed operand is forbidden, so the manual Triton kernel's steady-state cached bt (impl_triton.py:32-39, 132) does not conform to the decided rule and its column is recorded as not comparable (human_reference_comparable = false); this is a reference-measurement caveat, not a contract ambiguity. The reference's fp8-only cached repack (impl_torch.py:10-18) is reference-side work.

intermediate_storage.triton: bt (N, K) retained for the process lifetime per (data_ptr, shape, dtype) key (impl_triton.py:32-39); unbounded growth across the 60-case sweep.
intermediate_storage.note: Decided 2026-10-06 (owner, FINAL_FREEZE_AND_START_B200.md §3): a per-call K-major copy of B is a permitted, counted mapping-level intermediate; a copy that outlives the call via a cross-call cache is forbidden. The Triton side's persistent, address-keyed bt (also a stale-address hazard) is the non-conforming case covered by human_reference_comparable = false.

mutation.triton: a, b never written; fresh c per call (impl_triton.py:131).
mutation.cutile: a, b never written; fresh c per call (impl_cutile.py:82).
mutation.note: Idempotent for a fixed B object; see the stale-address hazard above.

hardware_dispatch.triton: no dispatch branches (host TMA descriptor path only, impl_triton.py:137-139,150-152).
hardware_dispatch.cutile: no dispatch branches; per-dtype default configs (impl_cutile.py:13-17).
hardware_dispatch.note: Descriptor-based vs tile loads and compile-time K (impl_cutile.py:39) are mapping details.

fq_boundary.bytes_expr: (M * K + K * N + M * N) * dtype_size
fq_boundary.note: The formula counts A once, B once and C once in the input dtype. Decided 2026-10-06 (owner, FINAL_FREEZE_AND_START_B200.md §3): it stays the declared lower-bound / compulsory-I/O model for scoring; the 2*K*N*dtype_size of traffic that a per-call K-major copy of B adds is counted in the measured time but is diagnostic, not part of Q. The cuTile path matches the formula with B consumed in its delivered (K, N) layout and no cache. The Triton path matches it in steady state only because the K-major copy is executed once per distinct B address and cached in _bt_cache (impl_triton.py:32-39,132), i.e. never timed after warmup, which the decided rule forbids; the Triton column is therefore not comparable to contract-conforming implementations. The reference's fp8 path (impl_torch.py:10-18) caches an analogous repack by data_ptr; its fp32/fp16 paths do not.

review_items: Decided 2026-10-06 (owner, FINAL_FREEZE_AND_START_B200.md §3): the K-major repack of B, if an implementation uses one, is inside the timed algorithm: per call, uncached, rebuilt by device work inside every run(); no prepacked-input assumption. The manual Triton timing excludes it (bt cached in _bt_cache, impl_triton.py:32-39,132), so the Triton column stays human_reference_not_comparable (human_reference_comparable = false); the cuTile column (direct (K, N) consumption, impl_cutile.py:64-65) is comparable. The open review item is removed from the contract (revision 2 retained).

Decided 2026-10-06 (owner, FINAL_FREEZE_AND_START_B200.md §3): the manual Triton _bt_cache (impl_triton.py:32-39; plain dict keyed by (data_ptr, shape, dtype), never evicted, stale-address hazard) is a property of the manual reference and is not fixed here; it is the reason the Triton column is marked not comparable. Candidates are forbidden from any cross-call cache of a transformed operand (contract Forbidden substitutions; evaluator_rules cache rule).

Decided 2026-10-06 (owner, FINAL_FREEZE_AND_START_B200.md §3): the documented precision class is preserved (TF32-class products permitted for fp32 with fp32 accumulation; fp16/fp8 native input products with fp32 accumulation). Process-wide precision flags (torch.backends.*, torch.set_float32_matmul_precision, allow_tf32) are evaluator state, not candidate-controlled state: the evaluator owns the reference's TF32 setting at verification time (impl_torch.py:4 sets allow_tf32 = True at import; matmul_int8's reference sets it False inside run()), and a candidate that reads or changes them is a confirmed violation (evaluator_rules forbidden_substitutions, confirmed, scope host).
